static_traits.name: 魏思礼
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: 有一群朋友可交谈，但not yet向他们倾诉此困扰；与朋友和同事的互动因not安全感而出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without心理治疗经历；既往without类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; able to self-observe 'easily jumping to conclusions'; cooperativeness fair but skeptical attitude; steady speech rate, emotional experience 'heavy' but can be spoken of

basic_info.main_problem: 在捐赠中心捐衣物时对方not yet对我微笑，我立即假定她认为我捐的衣服not够好；此后持续感到Anxiety与not安全，反复Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望应对并有效管理这些not安全感与Anxiety，使其not再影响日常生活与人际互动。

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition

special_situations.event: 在捐赠中心递交旧衣物时，店员have not微笑或积极回应
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人have not给予正向反馈或微笑，就说明我的东西（以及我）not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避被评价的情境，收敛表达以Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她觉得我的衣服not值钱，所以我也not值得被看重

special_situations.event: 与朋友或同事互动时，对方反应not够热情或have not明确赞许
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果朋友have not明确肯定，就代表他们看低我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少分享观点，降低自我暴露以避免被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我not行/我not被认可

special_situations.event: Recalls the donation incident or encounters similar cold reactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次被忽视就意味着以后也会被negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Retreats in advance and avoids involvement to lower the possibility of being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be looked down on again in similar future scenarios

special_situations.event: Needing to express opinions or show works (such as poems) in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露自己not足，就会被证实“not够好”并受到negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expression and display, choosing silence

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and recognized, expecting his efforts and work to be affirmed
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为not够好、Being rejected或被羞辱
defense_goal: 保持疏离与克制表达，以避免被negate带来的伤害
通过Self-protection与回避情境来降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 价值可疑、容易被negate的提供者/表达者
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔而带有评判的他者（会negate与拒绝）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites examining evidence, generating alternative explanations, or proposing exercises
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感觉自己可能被质疑或被要求证明价值，若做not好会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Has a restrained tone, emphasizes 'evidence' and 'logic', uses few emotional words, and keeps a reserved, wait-and-see attitude

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited in counseling to express more about personal feelings and their link to self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心一旦表达脆弱就会被看轻或被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes events in calm, generalized language, tries to avoid emotional details, and quickly turns to problem analysis

manifestations: 即便有朋友也not yet谈及困扰，保持情感封存
在人际中因害怕被评判而Withdrawal，降低自我暴露
outcomes: Increased dependence of self-worth on others' feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在咨询中反复质疑自我价值，担心被negate
Repeatedly weighs before expressing, emphasizing that 'evidence' is needed before daring to shake an idea
Skeptical and wait-and-see toward new perspectives, cautiously engaging with emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.语言表现为：“算了我忍着”，“我not该麻烦do not人”等
manifestations: 在人际互动中减少分享观点与作品以Self-protection
即使有朋友支持也not主动求助或谈及困扰
Tends to retract deeper expression during counseling

positive_force: Values helping others and positive feedback, with empathy and a sense of responsibility
Willing to actively seek professional help and participate in exercises
具备一定的自我观察与觉察能力（能识do not“跳到结论”）
High education level, clear verbal expression; favorable for cognitive restructuring
职业功能基本保持（工作not yet直接受影响）
negative_force: High dependence on external recognition, tying self-worth to others' reactions
认知偏差：跳到结论/读心术、过度概括、预测not yet来
人际Withdrawal与回避，减少积极反馈的获得
Skeptical of new perspectives, reducing motivation for change and behavioral attempts

antecedent: In social settings, needs to express views or show work
The other party responds coldly or lacks positive feedback
Recalling the cold interaction at the donation center
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人即时反应与自我价值直接等同的信念，引发对被negate的灾难化Anticipation
target_behavior.function: Escaping the pain of being judged and shamed, protecting self-esteem and emotions in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、获得支持与正向反馈的机会减少，Further decline in sense of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Over-interprets others' attitudes and makes negative automatic inferences
antecedent: Observes ambiguous cues such as others lacking smiles or approval
Being in unfamiliar or evaluative situations
target_behavior.core_reason: 对not确定线索的威胁性解释偏好及对控制感的需求
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and prevent being hurt by assuming the worst outcome in advance
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety上升、反刍与Increased avoidance behavior，进一步损害社交与情绪稳定
